_comment: IGN-: reworked 2026-06-06 from a mob_effect carrier that granted the ATTACK_TARGET minecraft:fire_resistance (a BUFF that helped the enemy -- wrong-way bug) to a thin-carrier + script-proc affix following the Skyshatter precedent. The carrier is now a small flat attack_damage bonus (thematic 'burning edge'); the REAL payoff is the on-hit fire-VULNERABILITY mark applied in kubejs/server_scripts/affixes/affix_effects.js (Igniting branch), which makes the target take +X% fire-type damage for a timed window. Per-rarity vuln pct + duration live in the script (IGN_VULN table) keyed by the carrier's rarity tier -- the apotheosis:attribute schema can't carry arbitrary vuln values. Carrier attack values kept moderate so the proc is the draw. Provisional values; tune after operator delta test.
